discrepancies.description: CommandPalette UI footer advertises "Navigate with arrow keys", but no ArrowDown/ArrowUp listener is wired in handleKeyDown.
BenchmarkDrawer modal cannot be dismissed via the Escape key (missing window keydown Escape listener; only dismissible via close buttons).
Component serves as an Axios interceptor telemetry console displaying live 401 refresh/replay events; header overrides and simulated rule creation are not present in the UI.

Light mode latency text uses text-yellow-600 (contrast ratio 2.94:1) and text-emerald-600 (contrast ratio 3.77:1) against white backgrounds, failing the WCAG AA 4.5:1 minimum contrast threshold for normal text. (Remediation: use text-yellow-800 and text-emerald-700 in light mode).
